svg.title: The path of an online payment
svg.desc: When a guardian pays with bKash, the money goes straight to the school's bKash account and the bills show paid. If the guardian already paid, they send a payment proof, which stays as Waiting for confirmation. When an admin or accountant confirms it, the bills show paid and a receipt is made; if they reject it, the guardian sees the reason.
